entries.name: Rondo Days
entries.capsule: St. Paul festival honoring Rondo, the Black neighborhood cut in half by Interstate 94.

Calculated from the usual pattern; organizers confirm each year
Calculated from the usual pattern; organizers confirm each year

entries.whatItMarks: The Rondo neighborhood and its families, displaced by I-94 construction from 1956 to 1968. First held in July 1983.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2026: Martin Luther King Jr. Recreation Center, St. Paul, noon to 7 p.m., with live music, more than 18 food trucks, 30-plus vendors, a youth zone and a morning seniors brunch. The festival was not held from 2020 through 2023 and later returned after a five-year gap.
